name: PSR-4 Autoloading Router with Middleware Pipeline
problem_statement: Implement a PSR-4 style HTTP router in PHP 8.3 with strict typing, middleware onion architecture, route parameter extraction, and execution order tracking.
source_code:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

class Router {
    private array $routes = [];
    private array $middleware = [];

    public function addMiddleware(callable $mw): self {
        $this->middleware[] = $mw;
        return $this;
    }

    public function addRoute(string $method, string $path, callable $handler): self {
        $this->routes[strtoupper($method)][$path] = $handler;
        return $this;
    }

    public function dispatch(string $method, string $path, array $request = []): array {
        $method = strtoupper($method);
        if (!isset($this->routes[$method][$path])) {
            throw new RuntimeException("404 Not Found: {$method} {$path}");
        }

        $handler = $this->routes[$method][$path];
        $pipeline = array_reduce(
            array_reverse($this->middleware),
            fn($next, $mw) => fn($req) => $mw($req, $next),
            fn($req) => $handler($req)
        );

        return $pipeline($request);
    }
}
unit_tests:
<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/router.php';
$router = new Router();
$router->addMiddleware(function(array $req, callable $next): array {
    $req['pipeline'][] = 'auth_in';
    $res = $next($req);
    $res['pipeline'][] = 'auth_out';
    return $res;
});
$router->addMiddleware(function(array $req, callable $next): array {
    $req['pipeline'][] = 'log_in';
    $res = $next($req);
    $res['pipeline'][] = 'log_out';
    return $res;
});
$router->addRoute('GET', '/api/health', function(array $req): array {
    $req['pipeline'][] = 'handler';
    $req['status'] = 'ok';
    return $req;
});
$result = $router->dispatch('GET', '/api/health', ['pipeline' => []]);
assert($result['status'] === 'ok');
assert($result['pipeline'] === ['auth_in', 'log_in', 'handler', 'log_out', 'auth_out']);
echo "PHP_ROUTER_SUCCESS\n";
